text.card: A red giant 3,729 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.91 solar masses and 7.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,717 K at its surface.
